purpose_of_the_trial: Exercise every branch of the repository reanalysis pipeline against real public data, and have the result judged by a layer that did not run it. This is a pipeline test, not a biological study.

destination.note: The mandatory default from CLAUDE.md, passed explicitly as workspace_root to every plan and download call. No raw data or MS-DIAL output on C:, in a user profile, in a code checkout, or in a temporary directory.

size.why_the_two_figures_are_equal_here: Three Metabolomics Workbench archives each serve two analysis units, the positive and the negative polarity of the same study (ST003038 x2, ST005052 x1). Only one polarity of each accession is selected, so no archive is counted twice. Selecting both polarities of ST003038 or ST005052 would make the naive sum overstate the requirement by the size of the shared archive.
size.disk_note: Retention is keep, and MS-DIAL Interactive holds both the downloaded archive and its extraction. Budget roughly twice the bundle figure on disk: about 26 GB. The gate's DSK-1 check reports the real occupancy per unit.

retention.rationale: A trial exists to be re-examined. An independent evaluator reading only the retained artifacts must be able to go back to the raw files when an artifact looks wrong. The campaign policy for a full-repository reanalysis remains delete_after_validated_output.
retention.boundary_5_note: Raw deletion is NOT exercised by this trial. The report must say so rather than leave it implied.

analysis_purpose.text: Perform systematic annotation of peaks derived from the analytical data, following a standardised workflow. Define a biological comparison only where the submitter declared an experimental factor; where none was declared, run with no contrast and record that.
analysis_purpose.consequence_for_the_gate: PUR-1 (compare the manifest's analysis_purpose against the Class proposal's purpose) is NOT added for this trial. With one deliberately uniform purpose it would be trivially satisfiable and could not detect the failure it was designed for - unit 1's purpose carried verbatim into units 2-10. A green light that means nothing is worse than no check.
analysis_purpose.what_analysis_purpose_actually_drives: Measured in msdial_interactive_app/msdial_app/mcp_server.py:224-236: it gates the download on being non-empty and is stored. Nothing branches on its content. It selects no library, sets no threshold, chooses no Class field and changes no QA criterion.

scope.campaign_scope: LC-MS/MS only, untargeted DDA or DIA/AIF/SWATH with an MS1 survey and product-ion spectra, one project type, ion mode, acquisition mode, chromatography regime and ion mobility regime per MS-DIAL run.
scope.selection_principle: Not ten arbitrary accessions. Ten units chosen so that every branch of the pipeline is exercised at least twice: three repositories, three acquisition modes, both polarities, five vendor formats, both download shapes, ion mobility on and off, Class decided and Class abstained, and a sample count spanning 11 to 168.

units.title: Untargeted lipidomics of WT and Cyp2c44(-/-) mice liver.
units.what_it_tests: The positive control. A clean, balanced two-group design, 10 and 10. If this unit does not come out right, no other result is worth reading.

units.title: Lipidome analysis of the muscles from skeletal muscle-specific GDE5 deficient mice
units.what_it_tests: The two-factor crossing, and the .wiff.scan sidecar role normalisation: 37 samples carry 74 file rows, half of which are sidecars that name no sample of their own.

units.title: A lipidome atlas in MS-DIAL 4 (Plants study)
units.what_it_tests: Ion mobility enabled, and the Waters directory format flattened into 477 file rows for 12 samples. This is the user's own published MS-DIAL 4 lipidome atlas data, so the expected answer is known independently of the pipeline.

units.title: Chemical Biology Meets Metabolomics: The Response of Barley Seedlings
units.what_it_tests: AIF, the third acquisition mode, and single-archive delivery: one URL for 61 samples.

units.title: Improving Metabolite Identification with DecoID for Database-Assisted Deconvolution
units.what_it_tests: The smallest unit, open mzML, and per-file endpoint delivery: 11 samples, 11 separate URLs. The counterpart to the single-archive units for the download byte accounting.

units.title: Untargeted fecal metabolomics reveals persistent host species-associated metabolites
units.what_it_tests: Scale: 168 samples, the largest unit. Also the bare `Factor Group` declaration shape, and the sample-type warning, because 18 QC samples become their own Class beside the four host species.

units.title: Customized Consensus Spectral Library Building for Untargeted Quantitative Metabolomics
class_refused: Factor Value[Sample group] (no_contrast: every sample carries the same value)
units.what_it_tests: Abstention. A declared factor exists and has one level, so it defines no comparison. The unit must run with no contrast and record why, rather than falling back to some other column.

units.title: Untargeted metabolome analysis of foods using LC-MS (1)
class_refused: Factor Value[food] (identifier: every sample has its own value)
units.what_it_tests: Duplicate formats: each of 16 samples is present as both .raw and .mzXML, so the file-role normalisation must not analyse the same sample twice. Also abstention on an identifier-shaped factor.

units.title: A High-Fat Eucaloric Diet Induces Reprometabolic Syndrome of Obesity
units.what_it_tests: A three-level ordered design. The timepoint must stay three groups and not be treated as a continuous variable.

units.title: HZV029 Lipidomics
class_refused: Factor (too_sparse: most samples carry no value)
units.what_it_tests: Abstention at scale: 140 samples, a declared factor too sparse to group them. The abstention must not become quieter because the unit is large.

negative_control.title: Comparison of Full-Scan, Data-Dependent, and Data-Independent Acquisition Modes
negative_control.expected_outcome: REFUSED, or split into three units before any run. The campaign accepts one acquisition mode per MS-DIAL run and this catalogued DIA unit holds 21 files of which 7 are DIA.
negative_control.why_it_matters: If all ten selected units are expected to succeed, the trial cannot distinguish a pipeline that correctly accepted ten from a pipeline that accepts anything. This is the only unit in the manifest whose correct result is a refusal.
negative_control.secondary_finding: The Class selector adopted Factor Value[Data acquisition mode] until 2026-09-20, which would have reported the acquisition method as the biology. Now refused as nuisance, and the selector falls through to Factor Value[Dilution] - which is a real grouping, and still does not make the unit runnable.

open_decisions_for_the_user: Ten units or five. Ten gives the coverage above; five halves the number of per-run confirmations and drops one branch of the matrix.
Whether to include the negative control MTBLS1572. Without a unit whose correct outcome is a refusal, the trial cannot show that the scope check works.
Which spectral library. It is chosen once and carried into every unit, so a library fault is a campaign-wide fault, and no artifact currently contradicts a silently empty load.
Whether to merge msdial_repository_catalog#6 before the download, so the tool's own byte figure is computed the same way as this manifest's.
